blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mylene Paat-Rezanova is treating every game of her 10th season in the Premier Volleyball League as if it’s her last. Paat-Rezanova entered the new season showing flashes of her old lethal form with a different mindset. The former league MVP made the most of her opportunity off the bench, leading Farm Fresh with 14 points in a 25-23, 25-22, 25-15 sweep of Galeries Tower to open its All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series campaign on Tuesday at the Smart Araneta Coliseum.
